families.topic: 24-hour specialist advice and laboratory support for imported fever and viral haemorrhagic fever
evidence_points: The Imported Fever Service provides 24-hour specialist clinical and diagnostic advice.
It supports assessment of possible viral haemorrhagic fever and other imported infections.
It provides molecular diagnostic routes through the Rare and Imported Pathogens Laboratory.
For other imported-fever panels, results are generally available on the next working day.
The source is an official GOV.UK primary page from UKHSA or another named UK public authority.
The page was live-opened successfully on 1 August 2026.
